svg.text: SA-L LEFT SIDE FRAME - AS WELDED ON THE TABLE (inner face up, viewed from inside)
scale 1:10 front (datum B) on the left dashed circles = rivnut holes in the outer face (underneath)
inner face up, front on the RIGHT
rear post is P3 (P2 is SA-L only)
SIDE FRAMES - FIT-UP AND WELD (make SA-L, then SA-R opposite hand)
1 Drill all members first (sheet 6). Posts outer-face holes DOWN.
2 Lay P1 + P2 flat, inner faces up, against a straight stop. Outside
of posts 1064 apart (datum B to rear face).
3 Fit S1 (base, top) and S2 (mid, shelf) between the posts: S1 base
flush with the post bottoms (datum A), levels per ordinates.
4 Stand U1 on the shelf rail at 160 and 830 from datum B.
5 Square each joint, clamp. Diagonals equal within 1.5, posts
parallel within 1. Tack 2 per joint on the up face; re-check.
6 Weld in joint order L01 > L12 (balanced). Up-face seams + the
short side fillets (3F uphill) - let each joint cool.
7 Turn over. Weld the outer-face seams in the same order, then
grind flush (* faces carry the side panel). Re-check diagonals.
8 Inner face up again: ledges, underside stitches only (det. C):
F1 floor, top 18 below S1 top; F2 partition, top 12 below S2
(mid) top, from 423 to rear post; F1 shelf, 18 below S2 top.
Gauge: an offcut of the actual ply on the rail top.
9 Flat within 2 over the frame (straight-edge the outer face).
fillet 3: top; flush: outer*, inner, bottom*
fillet 3: bottom; flush: outer*, inner; top: with cap
fillet 3: top; flush: outer*, inner, bottom*
fillet 3: bottom; flush: outer*, inner; top: with cap
LEDGES ON THE SIDE FRAMES (det. C, underside stitches only)
SRA-16 Silent AC Rack - welded 30x30x2.0 frame
Side frames SA-L / SA-R - fit-up, joints, ledges
FOR FABRICATION after hold point H1 (AC grille split M3)
